'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[East Aleppo offensive (2024–present)|East Aleppo offensive]]
***Clashes between the [[Kurds in Syria|Kurdish]]-led [[Syrian Democratic Forces]] (SDF) and the [[Turkey|Turkish]]-backed [[Syrian National Army]] escalate near the [[Tishrin Dam]] in [[Aleppo Governorate]], [[Syria]]. The [[Turkish Air Force]] also conducts [[airstrike]]s on SDF positions. [https://www.syriahr.com/en/352816/ (SOHR)] [https://www.syriahr.com/en/352846/ (SOHR 2)]
**[[US intervention in the Syrian civil war]]
***Deputy [[United States Department of Defense|U.S. Defense]] Press Secretary [[Sabrina Singh]] says that, despite local reports, the [[U.S. Army]] has "no plans" to build a military base in [[Kobani]], [[Aleppo Governorate]], which is currently under the control of the [[Syrian Democratic Forces]]. [https://manage.rudaw.net/english/middleeast/syria/030120254 (Rudaw)]
*[[Haitian crisis (2018–present)|Haitian crisis]]
**[[Gang war in Haiti]], [[Guatemala–Haiti relations]], [[El Salvador–Haiti relations]], [[El Salvador–Guatemala relations]]
***A contingent of [[peacekeeping]] troops from [[Guatemala]] and [[El Salvador]] arrive in [[Port-au-Prince]], [[Haiti]], to enforce a [[United Nations]]-backed [[Multinational Security Support Mission in Haiti|multinational security mission]] to restore order to Port-au-Prince amid an increase in gang violence. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/central-american-troops-arrive-haiti-fight-gangs-2025-01-03/ (Reuters)]
*[[Red Sea crisis]]
**The [[Israeli Defense Forces]] report the interception of a [[ballistic missile]] and a [[Drone warfare|drone]] launched from [[Yemen]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20250103-israel-intercepts-new-missile-launched-from-yemen-says-idf (France 24)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Proposed acquisition of U.S. Steel by Nippon Steel]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] blocks a [[buyout]] bid by [[Japan]]ese [[Nippon Steel]] for [[U.S. Steel]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cx2vz83pg9eo (BBC News)]
*[[Qatar Airways]] announces the resumption of flights to [[Damascus International Airport]] in [[Syria]] beginning on January 7, becoming the first major international [[airline]] to resume scheduled service to Syria since the [[Syrian civil war]] began in 2011. [https://aviationweek.com/air-transport/airports-networks/qatar-airways-resume-syria-flights (Aviation Week)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[January 5–6, 2025 United States blizzard|January 2025 North American winter storm]]
**The [[National Weather Service]] issues [[Winter storm warning|winter storm warnings]] across the central [[Great Plains]] and an [[Ice storm warning|ice storm warning]] in [[Missouri]], in anticipation of severe [[Freezing rain|freezing rain]] and [[Ice storm|icing events]]. The winter storm begins impacting the northwestern [[Contiguous United States|continental United States]] with heavy snowfall. [https://weather.com/storms/winter/news/2025-01-02-winter-storm-blair-forecast-snow-ice-plains-midwest-mid-atlantic (''The Weather Channel'')]
* [[2024–25 Ethiopian earthquakes]]
** Evacuations are ordered in central [[Ethiopia]] due to increasing [[harmonic tremor|volcanic tremor]] and other unrest at the [[Mount Fentale]] stratovolcano, which last erupted in the 19th century. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/risk-ethiopian-volcano-eruption-prompts-evacuation-residents-2025-01-03/ (Reuters)]
* At least twelve people are killed and 30 others are injured after a bus carrying tourists falls into a ravine near the [[Pan-American Highway]] between [[Pasto, Colombia|Pasto]] and [[Rumichaca Bridge|Rumichaca]] in [[Nariño Department]], [[Colombia]]. [https://efe.com/mundo/2025-01-04/colombia-accidente-autobus/ (EFE)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Air quality index|Air quality technology company]] [[IQAir]] reports that [[Hanoi]], [[Vietnam]], has the worst [[air pollution]] of any city on [[Earth]], with levels of hazardous small particles, known as [[Particulate pollution|PM2.5]], measured at 266 micrograms per cubic metre. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/hanoi-declared-worlds-most-polluted-city-authorities-seek-action-2025-01-03/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Egypt–Syria relations]]
**[[Egypt]] bans the entry of [[Syrians]] from all countries worldwide, except for those holding temporary residency permits for non-tourism purposes. The ban also includes Syrians married to Egyptians unless they obtain a [[security clearance]]. [https://www.newarab.com/news/egypt-bans-entry-syrians-anywhere-world (''The New Arab'')]
*[[Germany–Syria relations]], [[France–Syria relations]]
**[[Foreign Minister of Germany|German Foreign Minister]] [[Annalena Baerbock]] and [[Foreign minister of France|French Foreign Minister]] [[Jean-Noël Barrot]] become the first [[European Union]] foreign ministers to travel to [[Damascus]], [[Syria]], after the [[fall of the Assad regime]] to discuss new diplomatic relations with the [[First Syrian transitional government|Syrian Transitional Government]] and Syrian civil society. [https://www.spiegel.de/politik/deutschland/syrien-annalena-baerbock-reist-als-erste-eu-aussenministerin-nach-damaskus-a-6884f1be-3006-454b-9664-3ee76c0eda2e (''Der Spiegel'')] [https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20250103-french-fm-visits-syria-with-german-counterpart-to-promote-peaceful-transition (''France 24'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024 South Korean martial law crisis]]
**[[Arrest of Yoon Suk Yeol]]
***[[Corruption Investigation Office for High-ranking Officials|Corruption investigators and prosecutors]] raid the central [[Seoul]] residence of [[Impeachment of Yoon Suk Yeol|recently-impeached]] [[President of South Korea|South Korean President]] [[Yoon Suk Yeol]] to arrest Yoon for refusing to respond to three [[Summons|court summons]]. The raid is unsuccessful due to the [[Presidential Security Service (South Korea)|Presidential Security Service]] blocking further entrance into the residence, leading to a multi-hour standoff. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2025/jan/02/south-korea-police-on-way-to-arrest-president-yoon-suk-yeol-latest-updates?filterKeyEvents=false#maincontent (''The Guardian'')] [https://apnews.com/article/south-korea-yoon-martial-law-impeachment-detention-c8dc1758647979455dbf0d56e70369a4 (AP)]
*[[2024 Estlink 2 incident]]
**A [[Judicial system of Finland#District Courts|district court]] in [[Helsinki]], [[Finland]], denies a request to release the [[vehicle impoundment|impounded]] oil tanker ''[[Eagle S]]'', suspected of damaging the [[Estlink 2]] [[submarine power cable]] and carrying [[Embargo of Russian oil during the Russo-Ukrainian War|sanctioned Russian oil]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/1/3/finnish-court-upholds-oil-tanker-seizure-in-undersea-cables-probe (Al Jazeera)]
*[[War crimes in the Syrian civil war]]
**The [[First Syrian transitional government|Syrian government]] arrests Aws Salloum, known as the "[[Azrael|Angel of Death]]" of [[Sednaya Prison]]. Salloum is accused of multiple [[murder]]s and [[prisoner abuse|abuse]] of prisoners at Sednaya, including the murder of [[Mazen al-Hamada]]. [https://english.aawsat.com/arab-world/5097881-arrest-aws-salloum-what-we-know-about-%E2%80%98azrael-sednaya%E2%80%99 (Al Sharq Al Awsat)]
*A suspect is arrested in [[Rotterdam]], [[Netherlands]], for shooting and killing three men between December 21 and January 2. The victims were selected at random. [https://thesun.my/world-news/dutch-police-arrest-suspect-in-random-rotterdam-shootings-BO13480760 (''The Sun'')]
*[[Human trafficking in Southeast Asia]]
** Chinese actor [[Disappearance of Wang Xing|Wang Xing went missing]] at the Thailand-Myanmar border. He was rescued later (Jan 7) by Thai authorities. [https://www.thestar.com.my/lifestyle/entertainment/2025/01/08/chinese-actor-wang-xing-says-he-was-forcibly-shaved-and-trained-as-scammer-in-myanmar (''The Star'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Speaker of the United States House of Representatives election]]
**The [[United States House of Representatives]], composed of 219 [[Republican Party (United States)|Republicans]] and 215 [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democrats]], re-elects [[Mike Johnson]] as [[Speaker of the United States House of Representatives|House Speaker]] over incumbent [[Party leaders of the United States House of Representatives|House Minority Leader]] [[Hakeem Jeffries]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/2025-new-congress-sworn-in/ (CBS News)]
*[[Next Ukrainian presidential election]]
**[[President of Ukraine|Ukrainian President]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] says that the country will not hold [[Ukrainian presidential elections|presidential elections]] as long as the country is under [[Martial law in Ukraine|martial law]], even if [[Russia]] puts it as a pre-condition for negotiations. [https://kyivindependent.com/zelensky-again-rejects-elections-under-martial-law/ (''Kyiv Independent'')]
*[[Pula Nikolao Pula]] is sworn in as [[Governor of American Samoa]]. [https://www.samoaobserver.ws/category/samoa/112622 (Samoa Observer)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[SpaceX]] successfully launches the [[United Arab Emirates Space Agency]]'s [[communications satellite]] [[Thuraya|Thuraya 4-NGS]] via a [[Falcon 9]] rocket from [[Cape Canaveral Space Force Station]], [[Florida]], [[United States]].
